purpose: Deterministic offline contract for the deferred M5 local catalog/search and metadata backup benchmark.
runtime_scope: No production catalog, database, provider, OAuth, media blob, or UI behavior is changed by this fixture.

required_invariants: restored catalog metadata has the same canonical digest
restored user state is transactionally associated with the same item_id and revision
missing source remains visibly missing and is never guessed from filename

budgets.timing_note: Targets only; this PREP_ONLY harness does not claim product acceptance. Freeze machine, Python, dependency versions, and cold/warm protocol before measuring.
